UFS Irene Walt is a soldier and resident of Tokyo Kingdom City, appearing in Taimanin RPGX.

What are you laughing at...huh?! Playing soccer with the kids...were you watching...forget it!
Irene Walt



Personality
Irene looks like she is always in a bad mood, her hands are always tucked into her pockets, and she never shows them in public. She hates people and spends most of her time alone. For some reason, she is popular with children, and is sometimes seen playing football with the street children of the city.

She has a strong resentment towards her country, the underworld and the demons who run it, hoping to eventually leave the bonds of the state and DSO organizations and start a group to help orphans and abused children. She never shows her hands to anyone, literally. Furthermore, she says "she never shows her hands to anyone because she doesn't want to expose her cyborg nature", the truth being that she is embarrassed to be seen with her fingers, which have become machines.

Appearance
She has short white hair, blue eyes and a large bust. A few of her fingers are prosthetic, and she will keep her hands in the pockets to hide that.

History
Background
Growing up as an orphan in the slums of the UFS, she was ostracized by society and preyed upon by the underworld. Now living in Tokyo Kingdom, known for a bad mood but also popular with children. Her true identity is that of a combat hacker who also participates in battles, conquering the enemy head-on and receiving data from them.

She is ostensibly a freelancer, but in order to gain backing, she has become the exclusive external collaborator of the Japanese branch of the DSO (Defense Science Office).

Irene does not show her hands in battle. She does not use his hands in battle, but only his feet, and only uses his hands to type program code, as she lost a few of her fingers.

Timeline RPGX
Helped Brigitte and the Independent Commando Unit in the destruction of the Bullet Rain.

Timeline RPGX

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Legs

Hacking Tools: Her right ring finger, little finger and left index finger are android fingers, which allow her to type code at high speed, fit into the sockets of any terminal and access it directly, or take over nearby machines wirelessly.
